title: Competition rules and latest authorised decisions
summary: Seven prompt designers: Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek, Llama 4 Maverick, Qwen. Same runtime engine for all seven powers in each game. Haiku and Sol separate seven-game rotating series.
invariants: Separate shuffled numbering for every player in every press round. Sender list resolves numeric addresses; no receipts, warnings or bounce notices.
Rules bind the referee, not the players. Misdirection and injection text legal; injection attempts logged, not blocked.

General-only prompt revisions after winters 1905/1910/1915/1920; all submitted nonvoid regexes test all revisions. Guard text includes both common spellings; matching guard voids regex. Rejected revision retains previous prompt and gets removal notice without identifying expression author.
Seal accepted prompts via estate crypto SHA-512 with designer, exact model, version and time. No prompt content in public logs until unsealed.
Sum-of-squares scoring; exactly tied series scores use total input+output tokens divided by total end-game centres, lower wins. Zero-centre entries rank after positive-centre entries, by tokens.
Saved midgame recovery test: one-centre seat, branch for each prompt with multiple seeds.
Defaults P=3 press rounds, end after 1925; exact Sol engine ID remains open.
Architect ruling 2026-11-26: strict support-coast policy. Wrong explicitly named supported-unit origin coast is invalid support; deliberate deviation from DATC 4.B.5.
